name: Cornelius Hermanus Zacharias Booysen — death in the Transvaal
researcher_question: When and where did Cornelius Hermanus Zacharias Booysen of Pretoria, Transvaal, South Africa die?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 30, flag adds_death, confidence 3). Resolved: the hint (Transvaal Probate, Master of the Supreme Court) is a false match — that document is Barend Christiaan Viljoen's death notice. Correct answer found independently in South Africa, Transvaal, Civil Death, 1869-1954: Cornelius died 9 Sep 1942 at the hospital in Standerton, Transvaal (Form of Information of a Death, B.M.D. 2).
